svg.title: Honcho: a reasoner that works in the background
svg.desc: Honcho's architecture, with the running example. Writing: when messages arrive, a deriver makes one LLM call that extracts what was said as explicit conclusions; later, in the background, a dreamer reasons over the store and adds deductive and inductive conclusions, retiring outdated ones. Memory: conclusions at four levels of certainty (explicit, deductive, inductive, and abductive, which Honcho announced but has not implemented), each citing its premises; the vegetarian fact and a deduction drawn from it were retired. Reading: either Honcho's dialectic agent writes an answer from the conclusions (an LLM call), or the representation endpoint returns the conclusions themselves (no LLM call). All six constraints reached the prompt.
svg.text: Memory as reasoning about a person: conclusions at four levels of certainty, each citing the conclusions it was drawn
